citation.source_text: Products revenue was 70 billion, up 4% year over year, driven by growth in iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

claims.claim: Products revenue was $70 billion, up 4% year over year, driven by growth in iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

citation.source_text: In wearable's home and accessories, revenue was $9 billion, down 3% from a year ago.

claims.claim: Wearables, Home and Accessories revenue was $9 billion, down 3% from a year ago.

citation.source_text: You will see in our 10K the amount of CAPEX that we've incurred during the course of fiscal 24, and we will, in fiscal 25, we will continue to make all the investments that are necessary, and of course, investments in AI-related CAPEX will be made.

claims.claim: Management said Apple planned to continue necessary investments in fiscal 2025, including AI-related capital expenditure.

overall_summary: Apple reported products revenue of $70 billion, up 4% year over year, with growth in iPhone, iPad and Mac; Wearables, Home and Accessories revenue was $9 billion, down 3%. Management said it planned to continue necessary investments in fiscal 2025, including AI-related capital expenditure.
